sam (docs): Flagging a bug in the /responses API reference. The example request shows `inputs: ["hello"]` but runtime expects `input` (string) or `input` (array) depending on the model. The mismatch is confusing.

noah (eng-apis): Good catch. The runtime was unified to accept both `input` (singular) and `inputs` historically for compatibility, but OpenAPI now declares `input` as the canonical field. Docs should standardize on `input`. Runtime behaviour: if both present, `input` is used.

deepa (sdk): Our JS SDK accepts either shape too and normalizes to `input`. But the example in docs uses an array and the JS snippet wraps it incorrectly with `payload.inputs` which isn't in our client's types. I'll update SDK examples to call `client.responses.create({ input: [...] })`.

sam (docs): I'll update the curl, python, and node snippets to use `input`. Also add a short note: "Legacy `inputs` arrays are still accepted but deprecated; prefer `input` for clarity." Will include a minimal migration example showing old -> new.

al (docs-review): One quick nit: the curl example currently lacks Content-Type header. Add `-H "Content-Type: application/json"` and use canonical `Authorization` header casing.

noah (eng-apis): Also mention model-specific input shape: some models expect a single string `input`, others accept array for multi-input. Suggest adding this line: "Check the model's schema in the model catalog for whether `input` can be an array."

sam (docs): Good idea. I'll add a small callout linking to /models and an example mapping for single->batch calls. Example to show migrating:
```bash
# old
curl -X POST $URL -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"inputs": ["a","b"]}'
# new
curl -X POST $URL -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input": ["a","b"]}'
```

deepa (sdk): I'll push a tiny SDK PR that adds `normalizeInputShape()` helper and update the docs link to the helper usage. ETA today.

ci-bot: docs-ci: running lint checks... (warning: example code block language missing in one snippet)

al (docs-review): Add json fences for all examples. Also confirm the response schema example — current docs show `output: "..."` but runtime returns `outputs: [ ... ]` for models that support multi-output. We should show both single-output and multi-output response examples.

noah (eng-apis): Runtime returns `outputs` (array) in the general case. For convenience we also set `output` to the first element for single-output models. Document that behaviour and that clients should prefer `outputs`.

sam (docs): Updated PR with: standardized `input`, migration note, examples with `Content-Type`, json fences, and response examples for `outputs` + note about `output` alias. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3602

ci-bot: docs-ci: build passed. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-3602--redwood-docs.netlify.app/reference/responses#body

sam (docs): Merging after CI green. Will follow up to add SDK helper link once Deepa's PR lands. Thanks all! :rocket:
